subject: Falls Basin
text: The suggested level for Falls Basin is 14.

evidence.quote:
Location: FALLS BASIN
Suggested Level: 14

subject: Falls Basin
text: To solve the ice block puzzle in Falls Basin, push the first block 9 spaces up, 7 to the left, then 1 up, move the next block 4 spaces to the right, then 2 spaces north, push the next block 3 spaces to the left, move the other block 2 up and 11 right, and push the block near the entrance 1 left, 1 up, 2 left, 11 up, 4 right, and 2 up.

evidence.quote:
Push it 9 spaces up, 7 to the
left, then 1 up. Go through the passageway, and then jump across the large gap
to the left, using that ice block. Go down, and encounter yet another ice
block. Move it 4 spaces to the right, then 2 spaces north. Go back left, up the
stairs, and then go right. Jump across the ice block. Push this block 3 spaces
to the left. Go back to the other block and move it 2 up and 11 right. Go back
to the left, then down to the right, and up the small stairs. Jump across using
the ice block. Go up, and push the ice block that is near the entrance 1 left, 1
up, 2 left, 11 up, 4 right, and 2 up.

subject: Snow Crab
text: Snow Crab has 3,000 Hit Points, gives 234 Experience, and gives 6 Gold Pieces.

evidence.quote:
SNOW CRAB
Hit Points: 3,000
Experience Given: 234
Gold Pieces Given: 6

subject: Snow Crab
text: Start the battle by casting Fire on all enemies, then focus on Snow Crab with Thunder or Fire from Phoebe and Fire from the hero.

evidence.quote:
Start off the battle by casting Fire on all the enemies. Once the other enemies
die, focus your attack on the Snow Crab. Have Phoebe use Thunder, or Fire
(Thunder works better), and have the hero use Fire, or Cure (as needed).

subject: Heal Spell
text: After the battle with the Snow Crab, get the Heal Spell.

evidence.quote: After the battle, get the Heal Spell.

subject: Jumbo Bombs
text: After defeating the Snow Crab, Phoebe will teach you how to use Jumbo Bombs.

evidence.quote:
After the battle, get the Heal Spell. Phoebe will teach you how to use Jumbo
Bombs.

subject: Battlefield #9
text: In Battlefield #9 north of Falls Basin, use Fire and Jumbo Bombs against Desert Hag, Lamia, and Mage.

evidence.quote:
BATTLEFIELD #9
Location: North of Falls Basin
Enemies: Desert Hag, Lamia, Mage
Reward: None
Notes: Fire and bombs. Now that you have Jumbo Bombs, it should be easier.

subject: Magic Mirror
text: On 1F of the Ice Pyramid, go right to get the Magic Mirror, which allows you to see invisible enemies in the Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Then go right, and you can get the Magic Mirror. This allows you to
see invisible enemies in the Ice Pyramid.

subject: Noble Armor
text: From 5F of the Ice Pyramid, press up until you fall off the side down to 4F to get the Noble Armor.

evidence.quote:
5F: Go left, get some items, then press up until you fall off the side.

4F: Get the Noble Armor.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: On 5F in the center of the room, bomb the crack in the floor and fall down until you see a room with 6 blue statues.

evidence.quote:
5F: Go right, then move around until you get to the center of the room. You see
the crack in the floor? Bomb it. Fall down that hole, and keep on falling until
you see a room with 6 blue statues.

subject: Knight Sword
text: From 1F, poke any of the statues to fall to B1, then go down to get the Knight Sword.

evidence.quote:
1F: Poke any of these statues, and then fall.

B1: Go down, and get the Knight Sword.

subject: Ice Golem

evidence.quote:
ICE GOLEM
Hit Points: 6,500
Experience Given: 246

subject: Ice Golem
text: Against Ice Golem, have the Hero attack normally while Phoebe uses Fire or Thunder, since Fire takes off a considerable amount of damage.

evidence.quote:
Have the Hero attack normally, while Phoebe uses Fire
(Thunder isn't bad, either.) Ice Golem has a few nasty attacks, but nothing too
bad. Have the hero cure as needed, but if you cured before the battle began, you
should get through the battle without needing to heal, since the Fire spell
takes off a considerable amount of damage.

subject: River Coin
text: After restoring the Crystal of Water, get the River Coin and leave the Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Now, you have restored the Crystal of Water. Yay! 2 down, 2 to go! Get the
River Coin and then leave.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the
locked house and unlock it. Go in, and learn about the Mine, and gain the Mega
